desc_en: Citizen portal for consulting deliberations and official publications from Walloon local authorities
desc_src: Portail citoyen pour la consultation des délibérations et des publications officielles des Pouvoirs locaux wallons
features: Access to deliberations and official publications from local authorities
Advanced search by keywords, dates, and categories
Publication management with qualified eIDAS timestamps
Integration with iA.Delib for deliberation workflow automation (https://github.com/IMIO/buildout.pm)
Multitenancy: users and roles management for each entity
Multitenancy: customizable themes for each entity
long_desc: Deliberations.be is a web application that allows citizens to consult official deliberations and publications from local authorities in Wallonia (Belgium). It offers advanced search features and ensures compliance with regional legislation. Built on the open-source Plone CMS, the platform guarantees reliability and flexibility. It integrates with iA.Delib, a deliberation management system, to automate parts of the publication process and streamline administrative workflows.
